select PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, PTL_PORTFOLIO.INVEST_YESORNO investYesorno, PTL_RECE_POSITION.INV_AIM invAim, sum(decode(PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE,#{RECE_TYPE_01},PTL_RECE_POSITION.AMOUNT,0)) prinAmtTheory, sum(decode(PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE,#{RECE_TYPE_02},PTL_RECE_POSITION.AMOUNT,0)) chargeUnpayInterest, sum(decode(PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE,#{RECE_TYPE_03},PTL_RECE_POSITION.AMOUNT,0)) repaymentUnpayInterest, sum(decode(PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE,#{RECE_TYPE_01},fxxx.ysk,0)) capitalHoldPosition, sum(decode(PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE,#{RECE_TYPE_02},fxxx.ysk,0)) interestHoldPosition, sum(decode(PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE,#{RECE_TYPE_03},fxxx.ysk,0)) repaymentUnpayHoldPosition, sum(decode(PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE,#{RECE_TYPE_01},fxxx.fxje,0)) capitalPenaltyTotle, sum(decode(PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE,#{RECE_TYPE_02},fxxx.fxje,0)) interestPenaltyTotle, sum(decode(PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE,#{RECE_TYPE_03},fxxx.fxje,0)) repaymentUnpayHoldPenaltyTotle, sum(decode(PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE,#{RECE_TYPE_01},sffx.sffxje,0)) actPenaltyIntBj, sum(decode(PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE,#{RECE_TYPE_02},sffx.sffxje,0)) actPenaltyIntLx, sum(decode(PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE,#{RECE_TYPE_03},sffx.sffxje,0)) actPenaltyIntHbWfx, sum(decode(PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE,#{RECE_TYPE_01},drfs.AMOUNT,0)) earlyPrinAmtTheory, sum(decode(PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE,#{RECE_TYPE_02},drfs.AMOUNT,0)) earlyChargeUnpayInterest, sum(decode(PTL_RECE_POSITION.REC_TYPE,#{RECE_TYPE_03},drfs.AMOUNT,0)) earlyRepaymentUnpayInterest, PTL_RECE_POSITION.PAY_DATE payDate from PTL_RECE_POSITION left join PTL_PORTFOLIO on PTL_RECE_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID and PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = #{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_01} left join VW_REPAY_WITHOUT_INT on PTL_RECE_POSITION.BRANCH=VW_REPAY_WITHOUT_INT.WITHOUT_BRANCH and PTL_RECE_POSITION.FINPROD_ID=VW_REPAY_WITHOUT_INT.FINPRODID left join (select sum(PENALTY_INT_AMT) fxje, sum(RECE_AMT) ysk, FINPROD_ID,BRANCH, PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_SEC_RECEIVABLES where PTL_SEC_RECEIVABLES.CDATE= #{Cdate}- 1 group by FINPROD_ID,BRANCH,PORTFOLIO_ID) fxxx on PTL_RECE_POSITION.FINPROD_ID = fxxx.FINPROD_ID and PTL_RECE_POSITION.BRANCH = fxxx.BRANCH and PTL_RECE_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = fxxx.PORTFOLIO_ID left join (select TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CHL_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BRANCH, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.INV_AIM, sum(decode(TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.PS,#{PS_T01},TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_AMT*(-1),TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_AMT)) sffxje from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD on TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.TRADE_ID where TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BUSI_TYPE= #{BUSI_TYPE_37} and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS= #{TRADE_STATUS_01} and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL= #{YES_OR_NO_N} and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_DATE=#{Cdate} group by TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.PORTFOLIO_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CHL_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.BRANCH, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.INV_AIM ) sffx on PTL_RECE_POSITION.FINPROD_ID = sffx.FINPROD_ID and PTL_RECE_POSITION.BRANCH = sffx.BRANCH and PTL_RECE_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = sffx.PORTFOLIO_ID and (nvl(nvl(sffx.CHL_ID,sffx.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID),'999999')=PTL_RECE_POSITION.SEC_ACCT_ID) and PTL_RECE_POSITION.INV_AIM = sffx.INV_AIM left join (select ptl_rece_position_flow.PORTFOLIO_ID, ptl_rece_position_flow.BRANCH, ptl_rece_position_flow.FINPROD_ID, ptl_rece_position_flow.SEC_ACCT_ID, ptl_rece_position_flow.INV_AIM, sum(ptl_rece_position_flow.AMOUNT) AMOUNT from ptl_rece_position_flow where ptl_rece_position_flow.CDATE = #{Cdate} AND (ptl_rece_position_flow.INPUT_TYPE != #{INPUT_TYPE_04} or ptl_rece_position_flow.INPUT_TYPE is null) and ptl_rece_position_flow.HODING_TYPE= #{POSITION_TYPE_03} group by ptl_rece_position_flow.PORTFOLIO_ID, ptl_rece_position_flow.BRANCH, ptl_rece_position_flow.FINPROD_ID, ptl_rece_position_flow.SEC_ACCT_ID, ptl_rece_position_flow.INV_AIM) drfs on PTL_RECE_POSITION.PORTFOLIO_ID = drfs.PORTFOLIO_ID and PTL_RECE_POSITION.BRANCH= drfs.BRANCH and PTL_RECE_POSITION.FINPROD_ID =drfs.FINPROD_ID and PTL_RECE_POSITION.SEC_ACCT_ID = drfs.SEC_ACCT_ID and PTL_RECE_POSITION.INV_AIM = drfs.INV_AIM WHERE PTL_RECE_POSITION.HODING_TYPE= #{POSITION_TYPE_03} and PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = #{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_01} and PTL_RECE_POSITION.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secManageAcctId} and PTL_RECE_POSITION.FINPROD_ID= #{finprodId}
and (PTL_RECE_POSITION.BRANCH =#{liBranch} OR VW_REPAY_WITHOUT_INT.BRANCH=#{liBranch})
and (PTL_RECE_POSITION.BRANCH =#{bjBranch})
and (PTL_RECE_POSITION.BRANCH in(#{bjBranch},#{liBranch}) OR VW_REPAY_WITHOUT_INT.BRANCH=#{liBranch})
and PTL_RECE_POSITION.CDATE = #{Cdate} group by PTL_RECE_POSITION.SEC_ACCT_ID, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME, PTL_PORTFOLIO.INVEST_YESORNO, PTL_RECE_POSITION.FINPROD_ID, PTL_RECE_POSITION.INV_AIM, PTL_RECE_POSITION.PAY_DATE
select count(1) from STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SAI where SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId}
select branch bjBranch, TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, FINPROD_ID finprodId, nvl(nvl(SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID,CHL_ID),'999999') secAcctId from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL where TOTLE_TRADE_ID =#{busiCode}

select t.totle_trade_id, type3.type_8, dict.item_value, nvl(t.sec_manage_acct_id, t.chl_id) secacct_id, nvl(chl.finprod_name,stl.sec_acct_name) chl_name, f.finprod_market_id, nvl(f.finprod_abbr, f.finprod_name) finprod_name, t.vdate, t.mdate, pt.theory_prin, pt.theory_int, pt.theory_penalty_int, t.prin_amt, t.int_amt, td.penalty_intamt, t.trade_amt, t.trade_date, t.is_clean, t.remark, sub.totle_trade_id sub_totle_trade_id, sub.portfolio_id, ptl.portfolio_name, sub.inv_aim, subpt.theory_prin sub_theory_prin, subpt.theory_int sub_theory_int, subpt.theory_penalty_int sub_theory_penalty_int, sub.prin_amt sub_prin_amt, sub.int_amt sub_int_amt, subtd.penalty_intamt sub_penalty_intamt, sub.trade_amt sub_trade_amt, ptl.invest_yesorno from trd_fin_product_deal_total t left join trd_deal_total_add td on td.totle_trade_id = t.totle_trade_id left join pa_trd_fin_product_deal_total pt on pt.totle_trade_id = t.totle_trade_id left join fin_product f on f.finprod_id = t.finprod_id left join fin_product_type type3 on type3.finprod_id = f.finprod_id and type3.branch = 0 left join sys_datadict_list dict on dict.item_code = type3.type_8 and dict.dict_code = 'PINAN_ASSET_TYPE' left join fin_product chl on chl.finprod_id = t.chl_id left join stl_sec_acct_info stl on stl.sec_acct_id = t.sec_manage_acct_id left join trd_fin_product_deal_total sub on sub.p_totle_trade_id = t.totle_trade_id left join trd_deal_total_add subtd on subtd.totle_trade_id = sub.totle_trade_id left join pa_trd_fin_product_deal_total subpt on subpt.totle_trade_id = sub.totle_trade_id left join ptl_portfolio ptl on ptl.portfolio_id = sub.portfolio_id where t.is_cancel = 'N' and t.trade_status = '01' and t.is_overdue_deal = 'Y' and t.totle_trade_id = #{busiCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
